items.defect: mk_neg refused a WP-FHS-20 derivation (MULTI_CHANGE, changed=[]) but left the older neg_cell_fields_incomplete.json on disk, so the gate judged a stale artifact.
items.fix: mk_neg now deletes the stale projection on any refused derivation; the gate additionally refuses any executed NEG that has no WRITTEN derivation row.

items.defect: the loop's decision expression tested the cap before APPROVED, so a green cycle 4 was labelled STOP_CAP.
items.fix: precedence corrected to APPROVED first; the stored cycle record's decision was re-read with a decision_note. No cycle's verdict or criterion answer changed.

items.defect: EXECUTE_RUNS_LAST.json is overwritten per dispatch, so the writer-turn receipts for WP-FHS-03/04/05/07/11/17/20 were replaced by a later single-WP rerun of WP-FHS-02. The artifacts are covered by the gate and by module/fixture digests, but their turn-level receipts are NOT recoverable, and a re-dispatch would produce different bytes that must not be presented as the same evidence.
items.fix: run_subset/execute_wp now append to the runs record with history instead of overwriting; this round records the gap instead of inventing receipts.

items.defect: the write-guard refused build/journey_referee.py because the allowed prefixes covered only build/wp_fhs_*. The guard was right; the amendment (A-01) had not widened the WriteSet.
items.fix: ALLOWED widened by exactly one path in the same edit that records amendment A-01.

items.found_by: gate A section, three borrowed_scope cases
items.defect: three borrowed_scope mutations changed the scope of an evidence object that a different layer consumes, so the refusal arrived at the wrong layer with the wrong code.
items.fix: mutations re-pointed at the object the declared layer reads (WP-04 lease, WP-05 repo_context.subject, WP-07 cas); each remains a single leaf change.

items.defect: GJ01/GJ02/GJ03 declared FirstFail codes that no work-package referee produced; the journeys were prose only, so a declared criterion was covered by nothing.
items.fix: amendment A-01 adds build/journey_referee.py and GJ fixtures; section C now executes them instead of measuring name overlap.

items.defect: WP-FHS-02's digest chain carried no subject identity and WP-FHS-20's cell matrix had no evaluated cell, so the corresponding layers passed on an empty set (a vacuous gate).
items.fix: digest chain now carries the subject identity; two cells are genuinely evaluated with scoped receipts, so both layers are exercised.
